against storms of violence, and they take Church and State as their reward. Rebellion, sedition, is the product of the confused mind of the mob! And who's behind it? Heretics! Sorcerers! They undermine us! In town! In country!

@@U02258@@
(To 梅菲斯特.)

@@U02259@@
And now you with your impudent trickery are trying to smuggle them into our exalted circles.

@@U02260@@
(To the Court.)

@@U02261@@
Don’ trust them! They are kin to fools. Their hearts are depraved.

@@U02263@@
Aha! Now I know you for what you are! Men of learning. What you don't touch is miles away; what you don’t grasp doesn’t exist; what you don't figure you take to be false; what you don’t weigh you take to be weightless; what you don't mint you think is worthless.

@@U02265@@
This isn’t solving our problem. We still have needs. What are you getting at with your Lenten sermon? I’m sick and tired of the ifs, whens, and buts! What we need is money! All right, so get it for us!
translation:
@@U02257@@
对抗暴力风暴，他们以教会和国家作为回报。叛乱、煽动，都是暴徒头脑混乱的产物！谁是幕后黑手？异教徒！巫师们！他们破坏我们！在城里！在国内！

@@U02258@@
（对梅菲斯特。）

@@U02259@@
现在你却用无耻的诡计试图将他们偷偷带入我们的尊贵圈子。

@@U02260@@
（致法庭。）

@@U02261@@
不要相信他们！他们与愚人有亲缘关系。他们的心是败坏的。

@@U02263@@
啊哈！现在我知道你是谁了！学问之人。触不到的，远在千里之外；你不理解的东西就不存在；你不认为你认为是假的；你没有称重的东西，你就认为是失重的；你认为不铸造的东西是毫无价值的。

@@U02265@@
这并不能解决我们的问题。我们还有需求。你的四旬斋布道的目的是什么？我厌倦了如果、何时和但是！我们需要的是钱！好吧，那就给我们拿来吧！
